note.zh-TW: 直譯自日文的新株予約権；台灣多列在資本公積之下的認股權，網站維持課程名稱為主要顯示並加現行對照（設計說明見 T15）。
note.en: A direct translation of the Japanese share subscription rights; in Taiwan they are usually shown under capital surplus, and the site keeps the course name as the main display with the current caption alongside (see the design note T15).

definition.zh-TW: 持有人有權依約定價格認購新股的權利，在行使之前列在權益。本課未用。
definition.en: Rights that allow the holder to subscribe for new shares at an agreed price, shown in equity until they are exercised. Not used in this course.
